berlin-fl-ming-castles-and-empty-roads.slogan: A 196 km loop out of Beelitz
berlin-fl-ming-castles-and-empty-roads.story: Rolling south-west roads, brick villages and a low-stress rider day. 196 km round from Beelitz - plan on about 3 h 23 of riding. On the way it passes Bad Belzig castle hill, Wiesenburg park roads and Rabenstein castle. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows.
